text: Berlin, June 8.—Twenty-six machines having completed the fourth lap of the round Germany flight, 38 including four babies started the fifth and last circuit of 600 miles. The flights hitherto show that none of the machines under 40 horsepower completed four circuits. Eight under 80 horsepower succeeded, the best being an Udet with a 50 horsepower Siemens engine, while 15 were successful in the maximum, 120 horsepower class. Reuter

label: text
text: The great heat wave which for a week past has made life almost unbearable, suddenly broke yesterday on the eastern senboard. The glass has fallen twenty-five degrees in a few hours in the Boston district while the sea-breeze and a dense sea fog struck New York sending the refugees in the parks from the heat scurrying homeward for protection against the cold. Fatalities from the heat wave and storms totalled about 350. Meanwhile the heat wave continues in the west and middle west.
